description: Provides financial income support to landholding peri-urban farmer families in the peripheral villages of Chandigarh UT to meet agricultural input costs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: Landholding farmer families possessing cultivable agricultural land in UT villages.
Must have a valid Aadhaar-seeded bank account and completed e-KYC verification.
application_mode: Online via PM-KISAN Portal (pmkisan.gov.in) / UT Agriculture Dept

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi - Chandigarh)
description: Provides working capital loans to urban street vendors and micro-traders in Chandigarh to restart and expand their informal businesses post-pandemic.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 in tranches with 7% interest subsidy and cashback incentives on digital transactions.
eligibility: Urban street vendors operating in Chandigarh prior to March 2020 or possessing Certificate of Vending.
Vending ID card issued by Municipal Corporation Chandigarh (MCC).
documents: Vending ID / Letter of Recommendation from MCC
application_mode: Online via PM SVANidhi Portal / Sampark Centres

scheme_name: Chandigarh Urban Agriculture & Terrace Gardening Initiative
description: Promotes micro-farming, kitchen gardening, and rooftop organic cultivation across residential sectors and rural fringes under the Greening Chandigarh campaign.
benefits: Free organic seed kits, subsidized saplings, rooftop farming toolkits, and free training workshops conducted by UT Horticulture Division.
eligibility: Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) and educational institutions.
documents: Application Form available at UT Nursery/Horticulture Dept
application_mode: Offline via Government Nurseries / Department of Horticulture

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme - UT Chandigarh
description: Provides short-term revolving credit to farmers, dairy owners, and poultry growers in peripheral sectors of Chandigarh at subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh to ₹5 lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (after 3% prompt repayment subvention).
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers cultivating land in Chandigarh UT.
Individuals engaged in animal husbandry, dairy farming, or fisheries in UT villages.
documents: Land Possession Certificate or Livestock Possession Proof
application_mode: Offline through commercial banks / Lead District Bank Office Chandigarh

description: Provides end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople in Chandigarh including carpenters, blacksmiths, armorers, and potters.
benefits: Free skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest rate.
eligibility: Resident artisans of Chandigarh practicing one of the 18 eligible traditional trades.
Minimum age of 18 years; restricted to one family member.
application_mode: Online via PM Vishwakarma Portal or e-Sampark Centres

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY - UT Sector)
description: Comprehensive yield risk coverage for food crops, oilseeds, and horticultural crops grown in Chandigarh against natural disasters and pests.
benefits: Insurance payout based on crop damage; nominal premium of 1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee) growing notified crops in Chandigarh UT.
application_mode: Online via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in) / Banks

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - UT UT Division)
description: Supports peri-urban cultivators in Chandigarh with subsidies to purchase micro-cultivators, power tillers, sprayers, and shredders suitable for small acreage.
benefits: Financial subsidy ranging from 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural machinery.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing and cultivating in UT Chandigarh.
Priority given to SC/ST and women farmers.
application_mode: Online via Agrimachinery Portal / UT Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Soil Health Card Scheme - UT Chandigarh
description: Regular testing of agricultural soil samples across Chandigarh's rural belts to give customized crop-wise nutrient recommendations.
benefits: Free Soil Health Card detailing 12 critical soil parameters (macro/micro nutrients) and macro-fertilizer dosage advisory.
eligibility: All land-owning and cultivating farmers in UT Chandigarh.
application_mode: Offline sample collection driven by UT Agriculture Department

scheme_name: Chandigarh SC/ST/BPL Free Bus Pass & Welfare Subsidy
description: UT-funded social relief initiative giving free and concessional public transportation passes via Chandigarh Transport Undertaking (CTU) to vulnerable groups.
benefits: Free annual/monthly travel passes across CTU local routes for SC/ST, BPL residents, students, and senior citizens.
eligibility: BPL cardholders, registered SC/ST candidates, or senior citizens aged 60+.
application_mode: Online via e-Sampark Portal / CTU Bus Stand Counters

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission - Chandigarh UT Chapter
description: Encourages sustainable livestock management, backyard poultry, and fodder development in UT villages to enhance supplemental rural income.
benefits: Up to 50% capital subsidy on poultry development, goat rearing units, and disease prevention vaccination.
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and joint liability groups operating within UT Chandigarh limits.
application_mode: Online via NLM Portal / UT Animal Husbandry Office
